northStar: Protect dependable income while steadily replacing lower-leverage Encore hours with higher-paying freelance work and repeatable 3DVR revenue.
operatingRule: Work → earn → follow up → stabilize → ship. Revenue and reliability come before new feature sprawl.

items.title: Tonight — keep it light
items.detail: Organize, think, and improve Operator/Launch Room UX. Avoid turning tonight into another full work shift.

items.title: Encore — CIRCLE UP
items.detail: Protect booked income. Only interrupt the evening for a real client/revenue event.

items.title: Encore — Partnership Meeting A1
items.detail: Strong A1 day. Let automation keep leads, applications, and documentation moving around the shift.

items.title: First useful opening
items.detail: After the 6 AM–12 PM A1 shift: prioritize Tom/Phase 2 if approved, strong applications, client pipeline, then portal reliability.

items.title: Work-only day
items.detail: Do not overload this day. Keep business activity mostly automated and asynchronous.

items.title: Money/admin morning
items.detail: Use the open morning for freelance availability, applications, leads, and follow-ups before therapy at 2 PM and Encore 5–10 PM.

items.title: Main 3DVR leverage day
items.detail: Revenue pipeline first. Then stabilize Operator history/sync, Launch Room mobile UX, and the highest-impact reliability issue. Ship something tangible.

next30.title: Revenue sprint
next30.label: Sep 18–22
next30.detail: Use the lighter Sun–Tue window for fresh leads, high-fit job applications, Tom Phase 2 if approved, and trustworthy CRM follow-through.

next30.title: Earn + collect proof
next30.label: Sep 23–26
next30.detail: Four-day Graphics OP run. Treat it as income plus résumé/proof material while automation keeps the business pipeline alive.

next30.title: Productize the Tom pattern
next30.label: Late Sep → early Oct
next30.detail: Turn diagnose → small paid phase → safe execution → verify → next phase into a repeatable technical service that can be sold again.

next30.title: Make Operator the cockpit
next30.label: By Oct 11
next30.detail: Past conversations, plan, CRM state, next actions, revenue signals, and important calendar context should be easy to find from one place.

next90.title: October — prove independence
next90.label: Goal
next90.detail: Add at least one more paying client or strong recurring opportunity, keep pursuing better freelance AV, and make 3DVR produce real monthly revenue.

next90.title: November — make it recurring
next90.label: Goal
next90.detail: Shift from one-off wins toward maintenance, automation, website/server support, and narrow managed services with low support burden.

next90.title: December — scale the winner
next90.label: Goal
next90.detail: Stop weak experiments and double down on whichever channel actually produced revenue. Let AI handle more prospecting, preparation, CRM, documentation, and first-pass fulfillment.

next90.title: Long arc
next90.label: Direction
next90.detail: Encore stays the floor, higher-paying freelance AV raises the hourly rate, client technology work funds 3DVR, and 3DVR gradually becomes the system that finds and performs more of its own work.

milestones.label: independent revenue neighborhood to prove repeatability
stretch outside-Encore monthly revenue by year end
Operator holds plan, history, pipeline, and next actions
protected rest/family time in a normal week when possible
each month should require less Thomas involvement per dollar earned
